title: Simple FaQi
description: A really simple mod introducing several simple magical tools.
body:
**_Simple FaQi_ is a really simple mod introducing several simple magical tools.**
_Made with **MCreator**._
"Fa Qi" literally means "Magical Tools".
Everything in this mod starts at a "Qi Forge", which is crafted with Blast Furance, Smoker, Smooth Stone, 4 Smooth Stone Slabs, 2 Cobble Stone Walls.
**Right click the _Qi Forge_ with some items turns the items into some else:**
Diorite / Lapis Lazuli -> Raw Qi
Rotten Meat -> Rabbit Hide
_Raw Qi_ is an important material to craft FaQi's (Magical Tools) in this mod.
**There are 5 FaQi's currently in the mod:**
Leaf Parasol: Raw Qi + 3 Oak Leaves + Stick, grants slow fall when held.
Thousand Miles Boots: Raw Qi + Leather Boots + 3 Paper, grants speed when carried.
Leap Stone: Raw Qi + Feather + Block of Lapis Lazuli + Iron Ingot, grants jump boost and double jump when carried.
Water Shed: Raw Qi + Heart of Sea + 4 Block of Gold + Block of Emerald + 2 Block of Lapis Lazuli, grants conduit power when carried.
Fire Shed: Raw Qi + Ancient Debris + Bell + 2 Gold Ingot + 4 Leather, grants fire resistance when carried.
